title: Add primary-shard close to `merge-task.mjs`
description: Modify `scripts/merge-task.mjs`. After `git merge` succeeds (after current line ~53), before living-docs commit (before current line ~113): locate primary shard via `locateShard`, call `updateShard` to set `status = done`, `completed = now`, `updated = now`, append `notes` entry `[<YYYY-MM-DD>] Merged into <sprintBranch> at <mergeSha>`. Call `rebuildLibrary`.
acceptance_criteria: Shard transitions in-progress → done with completed timestamp
Notes entry appends without overwriting existing notes
Rebuild failure emits warning but doesn't block subsequent steps
Runs only on successful merge (skip on merge conflict)
notes: Reconciled: shipped 2026-05-01 (9c21730) — shard flag was stale.
